profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer and UI Engineer at Paramount International, I leverage my 15+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer and Marketing Strategist to create engaging and effective web applications and platforms. I work with a team of talented developers and designers to deliver solutions that meet the highest standards of quality, performance, and usability.

As a Founder of Closer Design Networks LLC, I have been providing advice and consulting to more than 200 clients around the globe on how to use digital marketing to optimize their results. I have created hundreds of custom websites and applications, managing multiple projects and budgets, and driving traffic and monetization for B2B and B2C companies. I have also handled hundreds of thousands of dollars in advertising through platforms like Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram, and others.

I am passionate about AI, Analytics, Big Data, and everything related to visualizing return on investment. I have extensive experience in building APIs, relational databases, and digital marketing strategies, using technologies such as PHP, Laravel, Java, MySQL, SQL Server, HTML5, CSS, Javascript, Vue JS, NPM, SASS, LESS, Git, and third-party REST APIs integration. I am also fluent in English and have a Duolingo certification of Advanced level.

I am a strong leader, team builder, and capable of implementing re-engineering processes based on data analysis, business intelligence, and reporting strategies. I am always eager to learn new skills, explore new challenges, and collaborate with other professionals. My goal is to use my expertise and creativity to help clients achieve their objectives and grow their businesses.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
I built a centralized platform to manage all the marketing assets and handle the communication for their brands Buy For Less, Uptown Grocery, Smart Saver and Supermercado. As part of the project I built an API to communicate to our websites and display information effectively as part of the automation strategy. I built their customized and unique Online Shopping Experience, and their Online Catering Platform. I also built a Micro Service to communicate with the POS environment at the store level pulling data related to transactions, movement and pricing so we could report effectively. I implemented as well their Email Marketing strategy using Amazon SES, reducing the marketing cost and increasing engagement and deliverability. I help manage their Google Ads strategy and their Facebook Ads strategy. I implemented Wifi access for customers at the store level collecting customer data using Zenreach. 

- Frontend Development
- Backend Development
- Marketing Strategy
- Software Development
- Automation
- Data Reporting
- Business Intelligence

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
I implemented the websites for their brands Buy For Less, Uptown Grocery & Smart Saver. I started their communication strategy via digital marketing by implementing automation via a centralized application delivering data via API. I replaced their Mailchimp strategy with and Amazon SES tool reducing the cost and increasing the size from 2000 subscribers to 90,000 subscribers sending around 180,000 emails per week.
